name: ServerSP
notes:
**ServerSP (AS214456)** is a hosting and cloud provider with data centers in São Paulo, Brazil and Miami, USA (Cloud VPS, Dedicated Servers, Colocation, BGP and BYOIP).

**Peering policy: Open**

We are connected to IX.br São Paulo and announce all our prefixes to the IX.br Route Servers (ATM/MPLA). If you already peer with the Route Servers, you should already be receiving our routes.

**Not on the Route Servers?** We are happy to establish bilateral sessions (IPv4 and IPv6) with any network at our peering locations that does not use the Route Servers, or that simply prefers direct bilateral peering. Just send us a request.

**Locations**
- São Paulo: IX.br São Paulo (Ascenty SPO02)

**Technical details**
- IRR AS-SET: RIPE::AS214456:AS-SERVERSP
- RPKI: all prefixes covered by valid ROAs
- Recommended max-prefix: IPv4 100 / IPv6 20
- We prefer sessions on both of our IX routers

**Peering requests:** peering@serversp.com
**NOC:** noc@serversp.com

Política aberta: aceitamos peering bilateral, especialmente quem não participa dos Route Servers. Contato: peering@serversp.com
